name: Law-enforcement equipment
source: IEEE MA-L registry; vendor documentation. Verify OUIs against the current IEEE registry before relying on them — registrations change and these flag the vendor, not necessarily a specific product.

rules.label: Axon / TASER device
rules.note: OUI 00:25:DF is Axon Enterprise's only IEEE MA-L block (registered 2010 as TASER International). Flags body cameras, docks, in-car video and TASERs alike — vendor-level, not model-level.

rules.label: Cradlepoint mobile router
rules.note: Cradlepoint IBR-series routers are the in-vehicle uplink for Axon Fleet and many agency vehicles. OUI 00:30:44 (and legacy 00:E0:1C) per IEEE.

rules.label: Agency radio / ANPR (AU)
rules.note: Australian agencies (AFP and state police) commonly field Motorola APX / MOTOTRBO and Tait radios, plus in-car ANPR. Name-matched only: Motorola Solutions shares IEEE OUIs with Motorola consumer devices, so an OUI match here would false-positive on ordinary phones.
